title: Vague, unprioritized musing about caching
notes: Very short, low-confidence, no clear decision. Tests confidence calibration and restraint (should NOT be inflated into a firm decision atom). Intentionally has only one plausible gold atom.

turns.text: I think maybe we should look into caching search results at some point? Not sure it's worth it though, could be overkill for now.
Worth keeping in mind — most searches are probably already fast enough given the corpus sizes we're seeing, but if that changes it's an easy win later. I wouldn't prioritize it now.

gold_atoms.text: Caching search results was raised as a possible future optimization, but not prioritized — considered likely overkill given current corpus sizes and search speed.
